title: Claim experience feedback request
description: Ask for feedback after an insurance claim closes with a one-tap rating on WhatsApp. Great for NPS and service quality tracking.
notes: Send within 48 hours of closing the claim. Quick replies keep the survey inside the chat, which lifts response rates.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your claim {{claim_no}} has been closed. How would you rate your experience with us?
